description: This file defines a utility class `ProductImageCropUtils` for cropping product images, including methods to determine crop viability, calculate crop areas, and perform cropping operations.

classes.name: ProductImageCropUtils
classes.description: A utility class for determining crop areas and cropping product images based on given dimensions.

methods.name: ProductImageCropUtils
methods.description: Constructor initializing the crop utility with an image and target dimensions.

methods.name: determineCropeable
methods.description: Determines if the image can be cropped based on size constraints.

methods.name: determineCropArea
methods.description: Calculates the crop area dimensions based on image size and specifications.

methods.name: getCroppedImage
methods.description: Returns a cropped image file based on specified rectangle coordinates.

methods.name: getCroppedImage
methods.description: Returns a BufferedImage of the cropped area.
